chunks: From him, from ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from Yūnus, from a man, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
There is no sahw in the Maghrib and Fajr prayers.

key_terms.الْفَجْرِ: the Fajr prayer, the dawn obligatory salat (prayer)
key_terms.الْمَغْرِبِ: the Maghrib prayer, the sunset obligatory salat (prayer)
key_terms.سَهْوٌ: forgetfulness or doubt occurring within salat (prayer)

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on sahw in the Maghrib and Fajr prayers?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning doubt or forgetfulness in the Maghrib and Fajr prayers. It indicates that sahw is not recognized in these two prayers in the manner discussed in jurisprudential rulings.
